evidence: 2026-09-30: real signup through the Agent Vault proxy using this recipe (MCP session, vault-minted password), browser egress through the owner's tunnel on a US network. Email, then a details step (full name, account name, password, a 'what will you use monday for' select, optional phone); submit led through onboarding pages into the monday.com workspace (an invite-teammates dialog over the board) with no code, link or CAPTCHA. A fresh sign-in with the same email and password was accepted and went on to a 'new login detected' page asking for a code sent by email; that page was not completed, because the proxy did not detect it as a challenge and refused a handoff. The only mail was a marketing reminder sent about five minutes after an earlier, unfinished attempt.
gotchas: Stepped: the email alone first (Enter submits it), then a details step with full name (#user\[name\]), account name (input[id*="account" i]), password (#user\[password\], at least 8 characters), a required 'what will you use monday for' combobox and an optional phone field. No code, link or CAPTCHA was asked for during signup.
The details step's submit ([data-testid="submit-button"]) stays aria-disabled until the 'use monday for' combobox has a choice; pick an option (role=option) first.

The account is only created at the end of the onboarding pages that follow submit: click through Continue until the workspace loads. Leaving on the first onboarding page leaves no account, and signing in then fails to find the email.
Signing in again from a new browser goes email, then password, then a 'new login detected' page that asks for a code sent by email. That code belongs to the account owner: hand it off.

On 2026-10-09 the details step's 'I will use monday for' combobox offered Work / Personal / Nonprofits; 'Personal' was picked. Two onboarding pages took 'Continue'; the next showed only a 'Skip' button that neither a click nor Enter moved past, yet the account already existed: a fresh sign-in worked.
Sign-in: auth.monday.com/login, email + Enter, password + Enter, then a 'New login detected' code step; the code is mailed to the account owner and is theirs to supply. After it the workspace loads.
